plans.evaluator_notes:
Premium is per person. For a couple, each spouse needs a plan, so double the annual premium and the out-of-pocket exposure (the app currently doubles individual amounts for a married couple).
Medical deductible in-network is $0, so every in-network service pays its copay or coinsurance from the first dollar.
Coinsurance-only items (drug tiers 3-5, DME 20%) have no dollar price on the plan page. Enter your own prices to cost them.
Out-of-network cost shares are recorded in out_of_network_services; the evaluator costs in-network use.
Part D has its own $700 deductible for tiers 3-5 and a $2,400 annual prescription out-of-pocket cap (limits.drug_deductible, limits.drug_oop_max).

extraction.assumptions:
Source is the Aetna plan details web page only; the Summary of Benefits and Evidence of Coverage were not read.
The drug tier fields hold the preferred pharmacy, 30-day retail amounts. Standard retail and mail order are in drugs.pharmacy_channels.
Urgent care in person is set to $40, the figure listed under telehealth 'Urgently Needed Services'.
General coinsurance after the deductible is not stated for this plan, so coinsurance_member_pct is null.
The 2027 coverage start of January 1, 2027 is the standard Medicare plan-year start, not printed on the page.
extraction.notes:
Ambulatory surgery center price is in outpatient_surgery_facility; surgeon and hospital professional fees are 'unknown' because the page does not list them.
Skilled nursing: $0 days 1-20, then a daily copay for days 21-100.
Star rating is 4 of 5 stars.
Part B standard premium for 2027 is not on the plan page, so part_b_monthly is null.

medicare.visitor_traveler_program: Nationwide travel benefit (Essential plans only): in states with Kaiser Permanente facilities you must use them except for urgent or emergency care; elsewhere you can use Multiplan or Banner network providers or any provider that accepts Medicare. Emergency care worldwide.
medicare.annual_enrollment_period: October 15 to December 7 (coverage for plan year 2027 starts January 1, 2027)

tier5.limits: Kaiser Tier 5 is 'Specialty-tier'. Tier 6 (Part D vaccines) is $0 and is not costed here.

tier2_preferred_brand.limits: Kaiser Tier 2 is 'Generic' (the key name is positional).

Out-of-network care except emergency, urgent, out-of-area dialysis and approved referrals
Comprehensive dental (optional Advantage Plus)
plans.other_covered_services:

plans.evaluator_notes:
Premium is per person. For a couple, each spouse needs a plan, so double the annual premium and the out-of-pocket exposure.
Medical deductible is $0 and so is the Part D deductible, so every service pays its copay from the first dollar.
Drug tiers here are the preferred-pharmacy, 30-day amounts. Other pharmacies and supply lengths are in pharmacy_channels.
Part D drugs have a separate $2,400 out-of-pocket cap and are not part of the medical out-of-pocket maximum.
HMO: care must come from Kaiser Permanente plan providers except emergency and the listed exceptions.

extraction.assumptions:
Quoted for the Essential King plan; Essential Pierce, Snohomish and Thurston differ on Tier 5 coinsurance (31%).
The drug tier fields hold the preferred retail, up to 30-day amounts.
extraction.notes:
Outpatient hospital services are $0 to a per-visit maximum and are not a separate schema field; the ambulatory surgery center price is used for outpatient surgery.
Surgeon and hospital physician fees are 'unknown' because the Summary of Benefits does not list them.
The star rating and Part B standard premium are not in the Summary of Benefits, so they are null.
The booklet covers 8 plans (Essential and Key for King, Pierce, Snohomish and Thurston) under PBP 024-031. It does not say which PBP is King, so plan_id is null.
Mail-order Tier 2 is $10 for up to 30 days and $0 for longer supplies.

identity.name: Kaiser Permanente Medicare Advantage Key King (HMO)
identity.carrier: Kaiser Foundation Health Plan of Washington

premium.note: Plan premium per enrolled person, from the Summary of Benefits. You also keep paying your Medicare premiums. Optional Advantage Plus Option 1 (dental) adds $75 per month and Option 2 (hearing aids, acupuncture/chiropractic/naturopathy) adds $26 per month.

limits.not_counted_toward_oop_max: Medicare Part D drugs (they have their own $2,400 cap)

preventive_care.source_text: Preventive care $0 (includes yearly Wellness visit, screenings, shots)

specialist_visit.limits: Referral may be needed; prior authorization may be required.

cost_share.limits: Medicare-covered manual manipulation of the spine. Medicare-covered acupuncture for chronic low back pain is also $15 per visit.

imaging_ct_pet_mri.limits: MRI, CT, PET and ultrasounds share this one price; prior authorization may be required.
imaging_ct_pet_mri.source_text: Other imaging procedures (like MRI, CT, and PET) and ultrasounds† $425 per visit

outpatient_surgery_facility.limits: Ambulatory Surgical Center. Outpatient hospital services are $0 to $485 per visit.

outpatient_surgery_professional.limits: Surgeon/professional fee is not listed in the Summary of Benefits. See the Evidence of Coverage.

emergency_room.limits: Emergency care anywhere in the world.

emergency_transport.limits: Per one-way trip; prior authorization may be required.

hospital_facility.limits: $550 per day for days 1-5; $0 for the rest of the stay. No limit on medically necessary days.
hospital_facility.source_text: $550 per day for days 1 through 5 of your stay and $0 for the rest

hospital_professional.limits: Physician fees during an inpatient stay are not listed in the Summary of Benefits.

mental_health_inpatient.limits: $470 per day for days 1-5; $0 for the rest of the stay.
mental_health_inpatient.source_text: Inpatient mental health: $470 per day for days 1-5 ($0 for the rest)

rehabilitation_outpatient.limits: Physical therapy; prior authorization may be required.

skilled_nursing.limits: Per benefit period, up to 100 days: $0 per day for days 1-20; $218 per day for days 21-100. max_units 80 = the charged days; the evaluator cannot model the free first 20 days exactly.
skilled_nursing.source_text: $0 per day for days 1 through 20; $218 per day for days 21 through 100

annual_physical.limits: The summary lists the yearly 'Wellness' visit under preventive care; a full physical exam is not separately listed.

diagnostic_procedure.limits: Diagnostic tests and procedures like EKG; prior authorization may be required.
diagnostic_procedure.source_text: Diagnostic tests and procedures (like EKG)† $20 per visit

colonoscopy_preventive_diagnostic.limits: Colorectal cancer screening colonoscopies are $0 under preventive care. Other outpatient hospital or ASC colonoscopy is priced as outpatient surgery.
colonoscopy_preventive_diagnostic.source_text: Colorectal cancer screenings† (Colonoscopies) under preventive care $0

diabetic_supplies.limits: Glucose monitor, test strips, lancets and control solutions; therapeutic shoes/inserts for severe diabetic foot disease. Prior authorization may be required.

dental_comprehensive.details: Not part of the base plan. Optional Advantage Plus Option 1 adds $75 per month: $100 deductible, then 50% coinsurance up to a $1,500 annual maximum (restorative, endodontic, periodontic, prosthodontic, oral surgery).

eye_exam_routine.frequency_limit: One routine eye exam per calendar year.

eyewear.details:
Eyewear can be bought from any provider; out-of-network purchases need a claim for reimbursement.
Eyeglasses or contacts after cataract surgery: $0 up to Medicare's limit.

hearing_exam_routine.frequency_limit: One routine hearing exam per calendar year; 2 fitting/evaluation exams per year.

hearing_aids.details: Not part of the base plan. Optional Advantage Plus Option 2 adds $26 per month: $3,000 allowance for both ears combined every 36 months (not per ear). The summary says this benefit may not be available next year.

fitness.details: One Pass: gym network, digital fitness programs, social clubs, one home fitness kit per year, online brain health training.

routine_transportation.details: Non-routine medically necessary transportation after hospital stays is $0.

meals.details: Member discount on Mom's Meals delivery; not a covered benefit.

worldwide_emergency.details: Emergency and urgent care are covered anywhere in the world.

pharmacy_channels.name: Preferred retail pharmacy, up to 30 days
Standard retail pharmacy, up to 30 days
